mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DAILY_TOTAL_DATA ( usage_date, line_id, total_usage_data, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{usageDate}, #{lineId}, #{totalUsageData}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) )

choose.when:
INSERT INTO DAILY_TOTAL_DATA ( usage_date, line_id, total_usage_data, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{row.usageDate}, #{row.lineId}, #{row.totalUsageData}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) )
choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO DAILY_TOTAL_DATA ( usage_date, line_id, total_usage_data, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE 1 = 0
